# deps: tools: up octosql to v0.11.0

Pin `octosql` at v0.11.0 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-392]] (v0.9.3; v0.9.4 and v0.10.0 came through Dependabot); the release notes are the [v0.11.0 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.11.0). A change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod) ([[DOT-96]]).
